div.div:
RAID
Redundant Array of Independent Disks
A storage technique that combines multiple physical disks into one logical storage unit to improve reliability, performance, and capacity.
Instead of storing data on 1 disk, data is distributed across multiple disks using strategies like:
- Striping: split data across disks
- Mirroring: duplicate data
- Parity: store error-recovery information

div.div:
CDN
Content Delivery Network
A distributed network of servers placed in many geographic locations that cache and deliver content to users from the closest server instead of the original server.
Idea:
Without CDN:
User (Taiwan) -> Origin server (US)
With CDN:
User (Taiwan) -> Nearby CDN edge server (Taiwan / Japan) -> Origin server (only if needed)
